name: Chikan Densha Kyonyuu Otori Sousakan ~Nerawareta Ureta Nikutai~
original_name: 痴漢電車 巨乳オトリ捜査官 ～狙われた熟れた肉体～
source:
The protagonist Mizuse Asami is a member of a secret government organisation. She deliberately baits serial gropers dressed in provocative clothing and then arrests them after obtaining incontrovertible evidence. Her organisation has a huge impact in enforcing the contemporary anti-groping laws.

One day, Asami boards a train as part of her undercover investigations. She's once again the target of molesters but something is different from the usual treatment. The overly brazen molestation escalates and all of a sudden other passengers participate in her violation.

All of the perpetrators turn out to be gropers who had previously been arrested by Asami for their crimes. They are now working together to violate Asami to enact their revenge against her. 

Violating Asami on the train isn't the end of their vengeance, rather it's just the prelude. The gropers force Asami off the train and confine her in a room...

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190731210845/http://ps-web.net/tryset_break/B002/02_story.html]product website[/url]]
translation:
主人公水濑麻美是秘密政府组织成员。她故意穿着暴露衣物引诱连续猥亵犯，在取得确凿证据后将其逮捕。她所在组织对执行现代反猥亵法律有巨大影响。

某天，麻美在卧底调查中登上列车。她再次成为猥亵犯的目标，但这次的待遇与往常不同。过分大胆的猥亵不断升级，其他乘客也突然加入侵犯她的行列。

所有加害者都是过去曾被麻美因犯罪逮捕的猥亵犯。他们如今联手侵犯麻美，向她复仇。

在列车上侵犯麻美并不是复仇的终点，而只是序幕。猥亵犯将麻美强行带下列车，把她关进一间房间……
